claims.claim: FPN, Neck and Head serve multiscale fusion and prediction purposes
claims.notes: Final architecture modularization is conceptual; source class structures can differ.

claims.claim: YOLOv4 includes a spatial pyramid pooling neck and PAN-style feature path
claims.notes: SPP here is detection feature pooling, not a multi-image crop.

claims.claim: SPPF in YOLOv5 v7.0 performs three sequential 5x5 max pools with concatenated outputs
claims.notes: Pooling subgraph equivalence to 5/9/13 requires stride-1 and matching padding.

claims.claim: YOLOv5 model configuration uses SPPF and top-down/bottom-up concatenations
claims.notes: Anchor-based head must not be generalized to Ultralytics v5u package configs.

claims.claim: YOLOX proposes a decoupled detection head
claims.notes: Classification and regression branches differ from GT assignment.

claims.claim: TOOD proposes task-aligned training with joint classification/localization supervision
claims.notes: Assignment is training-time, dependent on GT.

claims.claim: Head channel count A*(5+C) is for classic anchor-based detectors with objectness
claims.notes: Does not hold for all anchor-free/DFL or NMS-free branches.

claims.claim: SPPF three max pools are exactly equivalent to direct 5/9/13 max pooling in the demonstrated boundary convention
claims.notes: Does not assert equal latency or entire module equivalence.
